sources.notes: 将中文‘力觉’拆分为六轴力/力矩、关节力矩/本体接触、触觉阵列的力分布估计，以及力信号进入策略、世界模型和闭环控制四个检索面。

queries.label: dynamic-force-torque-manipulation
queries.query: (all:"force torque" OR all:"force/torque") AND (all:robot OR all:robotic) AND (all:manipulation OR all:policy)
queries.why: 覆盖腕部六轴力/力矩传感器进入机器人操作策略的直接工作。

queries.label: dynamic-force-aware-policy-learning
queries.query: (all:"force-aware" OR all:"force-guided" OR all:"force-conditioned") AND (all:robot OR all:manipulation)
queries.why: 覆盖力觉作为策略条件、反馈或表征的学习方法。

queries.label: dynamic-visual-force-fusion
queries.query: (all:"visual force" OR all:"vision force" OR all:"visuo-force") AND (all:robot OR all:manipulation)
queries.why: 覆盖视觉与力觉融合，以及视觉不可观测接触状态的补充。

queries.label: dynamic-contact-force-estimation
queries.query: (all:"contact force estimation" OR all:"force estimation") AND (all:robot OR all:robotic) AND (all:contact OR all:tactile)
queries.why: 覆盖从触觉、视觉或本体信号估计接触力的工作。

queries.label: dynamic-joint-torque-contact
queries.query: (all:"joint torque" OR all:"motor current") AND (all:"contact detection" OR all:"contact estimation") AND all:robot
queries.why: 覆盖无外置六轴传感器的关节力矩/电流接触感知路线。

queries.label: dynamic-force-controlled-insertion-learning
queries.query: (all:"force control" OR all:"force-controlled") AND (all:insertion OR all:assembly) AND (all:learning OR all:policy)
queries.why: 覆盖装配、插入等最后一厘米任务中的学习型力控。

queries.label: dynamic-force-safety-failure
queries.query: (all:force OR all:wrench) AND (all:"robot manipulation" OR all:"contact-rich") AND (all:failure OR all:safety OR all:uncertainty)
queries.why: 补充力觉在过力、碰撞、安全和不确定性方面的负面与边界证据。

queries.label: dynamic-whole-body-force-feedback
queries.query: (all:"whole-body" OR all:humanoid OR all:quadruped) AND (all:"force feedback" OR all:"contact feedback" OR all:tactile) AND all:robot
queries.why: 覆盖力觉从末端操作扩展为全身接触与稳定控制变量的工作。

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-force-sense-browser
browser_fallback_queries.query: site:arxiv.org 2026 robot force torque force-aware manipulation policy
browser_fallback_queries.why: API 欠召回时补充力觉策略论文。

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-force-sense-calibration
web_calibration_queries.query: 2026 embodied robot force sensing force torque tactile policy
web_calibration_queries.why: 校准近半年新方法名和术语。
